source.title: Should your belt match your shoes? (Or bag)
source.author: Permanent Style

tips.text: Belt and shoes needn't be the exact same shade, but keep them closely related, such as a mid-brown belt with dark brown shoes.
tips.why: Browns from one family sit together without looking forced.

tips.text: A brown belt can go with brown suede shoes even if the shades differ slightly.
tips.why: Suede and leather browns are close relatives.

tips.text: Never wear a brown belt with black shoes.
tips.why: Black has no shades to bridge the gap, so the mismatch shows.

tips.text: With black shoes, wear a black belt or no belt at all.
tips.why: Black shoes are formal and any other leather looks off beside them.

tips.text: With black boots and jeans, consider going beltless rather than adding a formal black belt.
tips.why: A dressy black belt looks out of place in a casual outfit.

tips.text: Treat leather watch straps like belts: keep them in the same colour family as your shoes.
tips.why: The leathers then read as one coordinated set.

tips.text: A pale tan watch strap can work with a suit and black shoes.
tips.why: Its light, strong colour reads as a deliberate contrast rather than a mismatch.

tips.text: Canvas webbing belts and fabric NATO watch straps don't need to match your shoes.
tips.why: Non-leather pieces escape the leather-matching rules.

tips.text: If you mostly wear suits with black shoes, carry a black briefcase; for casual versatility, choose dark brown.
tips.why: Black is the most elegant with formal wear; dark brown spans more outfits.

tips.text: Match the bag's formality to the outfit: attaché case most formal, then briefcase, then tote.
tips.why: A casual bag undermines a sharp suit, and vice versa.

tips.text: For the smartest suits, choose trousers without belt loops, using side adjusters or braces.
tips.why: A belt-free waist gives a cleaner line.

tips.text: In an open-necked tailored outfit without a tie, a good belt adds interest where a pocket square might look too showy.
tips.why: It gives a focal point without fuss.
